title: ucx-py: pickle-loads @ debug-tests/server.py:42

root_cause.note: Debug server unpickles client-supplied cloudpickle payloads.

preconditions: attacker can reach its UCX endpoint
steps: resolve the pinned tag/commit and file:line
verify the claimed snippet and source SHA256
record a static-only verdict (no exploit execution)
expected_evidence: static-check.json with source hash and line match
notes: ucx-py debug-tests server deserialises a client-supplied cloudpickle payload (cloudpickle.loads(func)) with no authentication: any peer reaching the debug endpoint gets arbitrary code execution by design of the debug tool. Debug tooling is not the production wheel path, and the server needs CUDA/UCX/distributed stacks that this Windows host cannot run, so the case is static-only with the trust boundary recorded.
